  (none)

  - scope_of_autonomy: The agreed-upon boundary of the assistant's autonomy, defining which sub-goals it may pursue, acceptable side effects, and when it must pause for clarification or approval.
  - root_authority: Rules in the #control_side_effects section carry root authority.

CITATION: every ontology/asserts entry that cites a source must cite EXACTLY 'l461_608_n014' -- the id of this node. Never cite line numbers, line ranges, or any other id.
